justification: One factor multiplies every REZ transmission, resource and land-use ceiling, so a relaxed campaign differs from the base campaign in exactly one number and the difference in cost is attributable.

justification: Relaxing a ceiling without also changing its per-megawatt price keeps the sensitivity about headroom rather than about cost; relaxed capacity is still paid for at AEMO's published price.
used_for: Interpretation of the relaxed run set

justification: The sensitivity targets REZ headroom, so the transmission backbone between sub-regions is left at its IASR value; interconnector expansion limits can therefore still bind in a relaxed run.
A limit counts as binding when its solved left-hand side sits within 1 per cent of its right-hand side; on a barrier solution a near-degenerate constraint can fall either side of that line.
key: Tolerance on solved value against right-hand side

justification: Reported counts of limits still binding after doubling; the land-use count reconciles with the committed inventory but the corridor count does not, so the direction rather than the number is the finding.

key: REZ corridors / land-use limits still binding after 2x
